sections.title: Why Hire SOS as Your Dana Point Moving Company
sections.content: Dana Point homes range from guard-gated enclaves in Monarch Beach to estates on the Headlands above Strand Beach and houses on the sand at Capistrano Beach, and each setting changes how a move is planned. We send CPUC-licensed crews from our Los Angeles headquarters with a clear hourly rate and the blankets and shrink wrap that coastal furniture needs. What you can count on: Licensed and insured: CPUC licensed, with USDOT 3398018, MC 1153871 and CAL-T0192140, full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Rated by customers: Google 4.9 across 1,007 reviews, and the rating block below is the same figure we publish site-wide. Straight pricing: From $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck Monday–Thursday at the cash rate, $135/hr Friday–Sunday, with stairs and long carries included. Call 909-443-0004 any day from 8AM to 6PM, or request a free estimate online.

sections.title: Packing Services for Dana Point Coastal Homes
sections.content: Between the harbour and the bluffs, furniture and electronics travel past open water and sand, so our crews wrap them before anything leaves a Dana Point home — the cover keeps off scratches, dust and damp, not just knocks in the truck. Moving blankets, shrink wrap, packing tape and wardrobe boxes are included in the hourly rate. How we wrap a coastal home: Screens covered: TVs come off the wall and go into blankets and shrink wrap, so screens and ports stay covered from the living room to the truck. Furniture padded: Dressers, tables and patio sets get moving blankets first, then shrink wrap to hold the padding tight. Clothes hung: Hanging clothes travel in wardrobe boxes instead of loose armfuls carried across the driveway. Rather not pack a single box? Book full packing services, or white glove handling for art, mirrors and heirlooms.

sections.title: Local Movers for Dana Point's Gates, Bluffs and Beaches
sections.content: Moving from a Niguel Shores townhome to a house near the Lantern District, or packing up a Capistrano Beach cottage for a long-distance move out of state, we sort out the gate check-in and the route along Pacific Coast Highway before moving day. Covered on moving day: Gate coordination: In guard-gated enclaves such as Monarch Bay and the Strand at Headlands, we send crew and truck details ahead so the guardhouse expects us. No stair surcharge: Stairs, long carries and multiple stops are billed at the same hourly rate, with nothing added. Setup included: We reassemble furniture, place it where you want it and help you unpack at the new address. Moves across the city line to San Clemente, San Juan Capistrano, Laguna Niguel or Laguna Beach run the same way, and same-day moves are available based on crew availability.

sections.title: Long-Distance Moves Out of Dana Point
sections.content: Census data puts Texas, Nevada and Arizona at the top of the list for Californians moving to another state, and we also run moves north to Oregon and Washington. Wherever you are headed, we plan the route, the packing and any storage gap before loading day. Planned for the distance: Interstate authority: Our USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871 registrations cover moves across state lines. Whole-house packing: Add packing services and our crew boxes up every room before the long drive. Storage gap: If the new home is not ready yet, your belongings wait in storage until it is. Staying in South Orange County instead? Our local moving service runs by the hour, and out-of-state moves get their own quote.

sections.title: Office Movers in Dana Point
sections.content: Moving a shop or office in the Lantern District, the compact downtown centered on Del Prado Avenue? Our office movers in Dana Point relocate desks, files and equipment, with moves scheduled Monday through Sunday.

faq.question: Can your crew get through the guard gate at Niguel Shores, Monarch Bay or the Strand?
faq.answer: Yes. Those communities, along with Ritz Cove and Beach Road in Capistrano Beach, are guard-gated, so share your gate instructions when you book and we will send crew and truck details ahead of time. Any rules on move hours or truck access come from your association, so confirm them with your HOA before the date.

faq.question: How do you protect a TV and electronics on a Dana Point move?
faq.answer: We unmount TVs and cover electronics in moving blankets and shrink wrap before they leave the house, so nothing sits uncovered on the driveway while the truck is loaded. Blankets, shrink wrap and TV unmounting are all included in the hourly rate.

faq.question: Will the Dana Point Harbor construction affect my move?
faq.answer: Revitalization work is ongoing at Dana Point Harbor, with construction fencing around active work zones and an updated traffic flow for the Wharf parking lot. If your pickup or delivery is near the harbor, tell us when you book so we can plan truck access and parking ahead of moving day.

faq.question: What is added on top of the hourly rate for a Dana Point move?
faq.answer: Rates start at $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck Monday–Thursday at the cash rate, and $135/hr Friday–Sunday. A $30 gas fee applies, the $50 deposit goes toward your total, pianos add $200 and items over 300 lbs add $150. Stairs, long carries and multiple stops cost nothing extra, and Double Drive Time applies under CPUC rules on longer local moves, while long-distance moves are quoted separately.
